correctness.rationale: Every poset on n+1 points is maximal-point extension of some n-point poset; directed graph isomorphism deduplicates all types. The seven-point count 2045 agrees with standard enumeration. Birkhoff gives all 2451 distributive lattices. Exact FO2 support-type recursion proves rank signatures 1,5,78,789,2449,2451 and explicit rank-five counterpairs. Independent exceptional-pair program corroborates the sharp separation, no infinite extrapolation.
